facts.fact: Casablanca Internet Exchange Point (CAS-IX) in Casablanca has 3 members listed in PeeringDB and 30 Gbps aggregate capacity, per Internet Society Pulse's IXP Tracker (data as of May 2026).
Two of CAS-IX's three members are registered in the United States (PCH AS3856 and PCH AS42, open peering) and one in Morocco (NPONE AS328055), per Internet Society Pulse (PeeringDB data, May 2026).
